  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.ibxsmartview.model.implementation used by com.eqixiac.equinix.ibxsmartview.model.implementation
    Class
    Description
    Alarm
    A streaming alarm message describing a triggered condition for an IBX asset, including its severity, threshold, current value and lifecycle status.
    Alert
    A streaming alert message describing a notable event for an IBX asset, including the event type, associated asset, tag and threshold details.
    AssetMessageType
    An asset message-type entry within a subscription's MessageType.
    AwsIotCoreChannelConfiguration
    Configuration for an AWS_IOT_CORE streaming channel.
    AzureChannelConfiguration
    Configuration for an AZURE streaming channel.
    Environment
    A streaming environmental reading (such as temperature or humidity) for an IBX asset, including the measured value, unit and the tag it was sampled from.
    MeteredPower
    A streaming metered power reading for an IBX cage, including the account it is billed to, the originating tag and the measured value with its unit.
    PowerAlertContactMethod
    A contact method (SMS or email) for power alert notifications.
    PowerAlertThreshold
    Threshold configuration for a power alert condition.
    PowerMessage
    A streaming power message for an IBX cabinet, carrying a comprehensive set of power measurements (real, apparent, contractual, current, power factor and seven-day peaks) each paired with its unit.
    TagPoint
    A streaming reading for a single monitoring tag point within an IBX, including the measured value with its unit.
    WebhookChannelConfiguration
    Configuration for a WEBHOOK streaming channel.
